name: lifecycle-p2-plan-skeleton-assistant
title: P2: PLAN skeleton assistant - explicit checklist/context/understanding writer for lifecycle readiness
description: P2 of the Lattice Lifecycle Proof-Or-Stop Readiness Check plan (docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-lifecycle-readiness-check-execution-plan.md, Suggested Story Breakdown). After the read-only V1 (P1, lifecycle_check, DONE), P2 adds an EXPLICIT PLAN writer that suggests checklist/context/understanding for a story, consuming the V1 StoryReadinessReport rather than creating a new readiness predicate. It is an explicit writer layer (opt-in), kept strictly separate from V1's read-only proof-or-stop boundary. Developed via host Codex/Claude CLIs.
